plugins.name: crbiz-pm
plugins.description: CRBiz PM for Claude Code. PM-as-Configuration-Overlay grammar with reference implementations of the discovery-strategy, tailwind-catalyst-app and zoho-catalyst-app archetypes. Install via marketplace on any surface; slash-command invocation runs in Claude Code CLI on a local folder or a Claude Code remote session against a repo (not currently supported in claude.ai/code Cowork). Bidirectional HTML board with IndexedDB-persistent file access, chip-spawn wrapper with per-chip git worktree allocation, Tie-back protocol, lean PM context. v2.4 of the PM-on-CC discipline adds the change-management surface the plugin never had: before this release the word CAB appeared nowhere in it, and the only route to a change request was one cell of one table row of pm-help. /pm-cr raises a CR or takes material a human already sent — a pasted message, a document — and turns it into one, quoting the source verbatim because their words are evidence rather than a first draft. /pm-cab runs the review with two hard refusals: no approval without a named authoriser and their authorisation quoted verbatim, and none whose RACI was not confirmed in that review. An eleven-state vocabulary drawn verbatim from the authoritative 25-state model, which also names the fourteen states it omits and why. /pm-lint gains I15, outside-the-wire detection, reading its register location from configuration rather than one client's filename, and keeping exit 2 "could not look" apart from exit 0 "found nothing". 42 skills + 6 agents + SessionStart hook + 2 PreToolUse hooks (git-stage-guard + worktree-visibility-guard); /pm-lint runs 24 checks.

plugins.name: crbiz-skills
plugins.description: CRBiz's own Claude skills for Zoho consulting. An L0 foundation — platform mechanics (OAuth, data centres, API credits), the Deluge language, the product catalogue and persona-based licensing architecture — under six L1 product specialists: CRM on API v8 (Composite, Bulk, COQL, GraphQL, Notification), Desk, Analytics, Catalyst, Field Service Management, and the finance suite (Books, Invoice, Billing, Inventory, Expense, Payroll). Each specialist keeps judgement in SKILL.md, depth in references/, and carries a dated source note recording what was verified, against which documentation, and what could not be — so a stale fact is visible rather than inferred. Also ships BRD/PRD elicitation, WordPress and SEO migration, and finance and mail administration. Working conventions ship as a SessionStart hook so language and output format are right in the first reply rather than after a skill happens to trigger. Identity, agent-to-agent escalation, BAU and bug structure, and client-area layout are owned by the Global PM BRD and referenced, never restated. 18 skills + 1 agent + SessionStart hook + a six-check validation harness.
